title: Dominic and the Colony
author: Yara Ashgrove
blurb: Elodie Eastwick, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
